species_upkeep.desc: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook. They also conduct cold temperatures, which can threaten their health in colder climates.

items.desc:
£pop£ §HLivestock Pops§! cannot be employed to produce resources, but are instead kept around to increase the £food£ §HFood§! supply.

Instead, Lithoid Livestock produce £minerals£ §HMinerals§! and Thermophile Livestock produce £alloys£ §HAlloys§!.
